head: working-tree
subject: Delta SDS TTL expiry and heartbeat refresh
change: Cached SDS secrets now carry a delta Resource.ttl deadline. Payload-free heartbeats refresh the deadline, nextDeltaExpiry includes secret timers, and expireDeltaWithDeadline removes expired secrets, forgets their accepted versions, and reprojects referencing clusters back to pending. SotW secrets remain untimed.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/runtime/sds_tests.zig 'gRPC delta xDS runtime expires SDS secrets and refreshes their TTL' covers short-TTL resolution, heartbeat refresh, timer clearing, expiry back to pending with endpoint removal and accepted-version forgetting, and restoration without a timer.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' --summary all

full_library.notes: An earlier full run under host load 12-16 crashed one SOCKS5 test in its test-only socket close path; the same test passed in isolation and the rerun passed with no failures.

notes: SotW secrets have no TTL. SDS delta heartbeats for unknown names are ignored.
